text:
maya (Design): Flagging a quick design review for a compact scrubber variant + sampled-data affordance. Prototype here: https://redwood.design/proto/compact-scrub?v=3 :link:

dez (Frontend): Quick q: are we solving mobile cramped layouts or desktop small panels? Two slightly different approaches.

maya (Design): Primary: medium-width panels where the p95 pill collides with the heatmap scrubber. Secondary: clearer signal that the heatmap may be sampled (esp. 30d+ ranges).

kiran (Observability): FYI we've had 7 support tickets this quarter where customers interpreted heatmap color differences as absolute counts. That's the driver. We should show sampling ratio somewhere obvious.

ops-bot: Deploy note: heatmap v2 renderer rolled 3 days ago to staging. Observability flagged slight fps degradation on Intel iGPU in Chrome.

rachel (A11y): Accessibility checklist off the top: color-only doesn't work, need text fallback via tooltip and an accessible description. If we're marking buckets as sampled-heavy we must ensure pattern fills are keyboard-toggleable and have readable alt text.

dez (Frontend): Implementation idea: collapse text pill into an icon-only chip when width < 420px. Icon has aria-label="p95 123ms, sampled". Clicking opens a small panel with: sampling ratio, time-range used, "Compute exact p95" CTA. Panel keyboard shortcut: focus + press `S`.

maya (Design): Copy choices for the panel header: Option A: "Sampled results" (short) Option B: "Estimated from sampled traces" (explicit). Which do we prefer?

kiran (Observability): I'd vote B for precision; we can shorten on the chip to "Sampled" but panel should explain. Also include example: "Estimated p95 123ms (sample ratio 1:10) — full compute may take ~2min."

rachel (A11y): For color+pattern: prefer diagonal hatch for low intensity, dot-pattern for medium, solid for high. Provide a toggle in user settings "High contrast / patterns". Ensure contrast ratios meet WCAG 2.1 (4.5:1) for text over amber backgrounds.

dez (Frontend): Pattern overlay idea: keep default canvas colors for perf, add an optional SVG overlay for patterns when `prefers-contrast: high` or `settings.patterns===true`. That avoids double draw for normal users. Will prototype both.

maya (Design): Microcopy draft for chip tooltip:
- line 1: "Showing sampled results (1 in 10 traces)"
- line 2: "Request exact p95 (async)"
Button label: "Compute exact p95"

ops-bot: Note: quota/guardrails reminder: bulk "compute exact" requests will be rate-limited. See internal API doc: POST /api/v1/observability/compute-p95 : 30req/min per org limit.

kiran (Observability): Backend suggestion: return an estimated ETA in response and a job id, then push status updates via websocket so UI can show progress. Also cache recent full-compute results for 10m to avoid duplicate work.

rachel (A11y): Keyboard flow: user tabs to scrubber -> chip (aria-haspopup) -> press Enter or S to open panel -> panel should trap focus, announce via aria-live: "Full p95 computation queued, ETA 2 minutes". Also provide a dismissible inline explanation for screen readers.

dez (Frontend): Small UX trade: showing ETA may encourage users to spam compute button. UI suggestion: disable button and show countdown once clicked, with a small help link "Why compute takes time".

maya (Design): Styling notes: use amber-600 for the sampled chip background, white chip text, 12px font, 6px horizontal padding. On hover show a 1px dark border for affordance. For patterns use subtle 20% opacity overlays.

kiran (Observability): For telemetry/QA we should log: range length, sample ratio, user action (requested full), response time, job completion time, and p95 delta between sampled vs full. I'll add to the observability instrumentation checklist.

rachel (A11y): Also run colorblind sims for 3 common palettes and ensure pattern legend has alt text.

maya (Design): Decisions for this sprint:
- compact chip (icon-first) below 420px, full text chip otherwise
- chip label: "Sampled"; tooltip/panel uses explicit copy (Option B)
- panel: sampling ratio + "Compute exact p95" async CTA with ETA
- patterns: opt-in via user settings/high-contrast; SVG overlay only in these modes
- keyboard shortcut: `S` to open panel when scrubber focused; use `aria-live` announcements

sam_ops: I'll draft the API contract (rate limits + job status) and add org-level guardrails. Also will add a fast-path approximate aggregation option if teams prefer cheaper estimates.

maya (Design): Thanks all. @de s @rachel @kiran @sam_ops please drop prototypes or API PRs in the thread. I'll follow up with final microcopy. :sparkles:"
